text:
Ana: Quick sync 1 1: we need a locked webinar plan: title, 2-3 speakers, rehearsal dates, and lead routing. Deadline EOD today.

Mei: Proposed title: 'Serving Large Models: Practical knobs for performance & cost' 1. Short abstract below.

Mei: Abstract draft: 'Hands-on session showing real tactics teams use to hit latency SLOs while keeping token costs predictable. Well cover batching strategies, prefix caching, quantization tradeoffs, and routing fallbacks with benchmark takeaways.'

Jake: Make headline less jargon-y for marketing emails. Suggest: 'Serve LLMs Faster & Cheaper: Proven operational tricks'.

Ana: Agreed. Use Jake's headline for landing page H1; Mei keep the abstract for details.

Sam: Speakers: Ana to moderate, Marco for runtime/demo, and Tobias for customer-facing case studies. Rhea is out that week.

Tobias: I can present a short case about a customer who cut inference costs 3x by changing cache policy + model routing. I need 5 slides and the logs + before/after numbers.

Marco: For the demo: scripted flow with deterministic inputs. Live demo shows KV cache hit vs cold path + a graceful fallback to a smaller quantized model. I'll prepare a short recorded clip as backup.

Lina: Lead routing: landing form should have checkbox "I want a follow-up demo". If checked, tag lead: `webinar_inquiry` and set SFDC owner to AE-rotation. Also add `utm_source=webinar` to landing links.

Jake: Confirmation email copy: 1) Thanks 2) calendar invite link 3) CTA to request demo 4) link to benchmark one-pager. I'll draft and post by 5pm.

Ana: Rehearsal plan:
```
- Tech check (30m) 
- Full run (60m) with transitions and Q&A simulation
- Dress rehearsal with panel (20m) immediately before live
```
Suggest dates: tech check Wed 10:00 UTC, full run Fri 16:00 UTC. Sam to confirm room + streaming creds.

Sam: Booked Zoom webinar slot and backstage channel. I'll DM streaming creds to presenters. Also set up a dedicated Slack channel for day-of ops.

Marco: Demo failover: recorded clip in GDrive + local HTML export. If latency spikes, exec `pause_demo.sh` and play clip. I'll add commands in the runbook.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: publish event page draft at https://redwood.com/events/draft (private)

Mei: Assets owner matrix: slides (Mei + Tobias), demo script (Marco), one-pager benchmark (Mei), landing copy (Jake), follow-up email (Jake), event page QA (Ana).

Ana: Run-of-show (timeboxed):
```
- 0:00 - 5:00 Welcome + agenda
- 5:00 - 15:00 Benchmark story + visuals
- 15:00 - 35:00 Live demo + explainers
- 35:00 - 50:00 Customer case + lessons learned
- 50:00 - 60:00 Q&A + CTA
```
Keep Q&A flexible if many questions.

Lina: For tracking, add hidden form field `utm_campaign=serving_playbook_q2` and pass `demo_interest=true` to CRM. Can we also attach the AE note template for SDRs?

Ana: Yes. Lina send template and I'll review. Also recommend two subject lines for A/B test.

Jake: I'll wire up GA + conversion events, and create UTM links for paid promo. Also recommend a short tweet-thread + LinkedIn post with benchmark highlights.

Tobias: Need copy approval for customer slide. I'll send to legal & customer success for sign-off.

Ana: Action items recap: Mei finalize abstract + slides; Marco prep demo script + backup recording; Jake landing + emails + utm; Sam book rehearsals + backstage; Lina configure lead routing + AE template; Tobias get customer approvals. Everyone confirm by EOD. :thumbsup:

Mei: Confirmed 1

Marco: Confirmed. will upload backup by EOD.

Jake: Confirmed. Draft email by 5pm.

Lina: Confirmed. Will add SDR checklist.

Sam: Confirmed. Rehearsal invites sent.

Ana: Thanks team. If anything changes ping here.
